6.2.rationale: The Indonesian regulation mentions trafficking (Pasal 16(1) huruf b includes prevention of violence against women including trafficking; Pasal 1 angka 16 defines trafficking; Pasal 53(1) huruf b includes child victims of trafficking for social welfare). However, the indicator is about an intersectional approach specifically addressing trafficking victims as a distinct vulnerable group (typically with tailored measures/services). The retrieved passages mainly show trafficking is within scope/definitions and mentioned in prevention, but do not clearly set out specific victim-centered provisions for trafficking victims (especially women) beyond general violence-victim services. The judge inferred that mere mention/definition equals an intersectional trafficking-victims approach, which is an overreach.
